ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM shall: (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination, at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return to Customer, or make available for retrieval by Customer, all Content in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all Content remaining in IBM's systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We added an orderly exit right: up to six months of transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter, since the Effect of Termination section is currently silent on data return. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance with the same thirty-day export window.
input.summary: Insert transition assistance and Content return/deletion obligations into Section 3.5 (Effect of Termination).
